mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, agent_id, contract_id, performance_month, deal_amount, commission_amount, performance_status, settle_time, create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT agent_id, SUM(commission_amount) AS total_amount -- 按佣金金额统计总和（单位：元） FROM agent_performance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND performance_status != 'CANCELED' -- 排除已取消的业绩
AND performance_month = DATE_FORMAT(#{statisticDate}, '%Y%m')
AND performance_month BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{statisticDate}, '%Y') + LPAD(FLOOR((MONTH(#{statisticDate})-1)/3)*3 + 1, 2, '0') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{statisticDate}, '%Y') + LPAD(FLOOR((MONTH(#{statisticDate})-1)/3)*3 + 3, 2, '0')
AND performance_month LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(#{statisticDate}, '%Y'), '%')
GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC
